title: A lower bound for biased majority
statement: Let $m$ be a nonnegative integer and let $C\geq0$ satisfy $C/\sqrt{2m+1}\leq\frac12$. For independent signs, each equal to $-1$ with probability $p=\frac12+C/\sqrt{2m+1}$ and to $1$ otherwise, the probability that their majority is $-1$ is at least $1-2\exp(-2C^2)$.
